subject: physics
title: Energy Stores & Transfers - Foundations
welcome_lead: Meet the 8 stores and how energy moves between them.
meta_desc: KS3 Physics: foundations of energy stores and transfer pathways.
final_note: Energy mapped! You can name every store and how it moves.

concepts.def: Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.
Energy in hotter objects; transferred when in contact with cooler ones.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Scientists list 8 energy stores:

Chemical - food, fuel, batteries.
Kinetic - anything moving.
Gravitational - anything lifted up.
Elastic - springs, rubber bands.
Thermal - hot objects.
Magnetic - magnets near magnetic stuff.
Electrostatic - charged things.
Nuclear - inside atoms.

Energy moves between stores via 4 pathways:

Mechanically - a force does work.
Electrically - current in a wire.
Heating - hot to cold.
Radiation - waves like light or sound.

Stores hold energy; pathways move it!

You eat a banana (chemical) and walk - chemical -> kinetic (mechanically).

A torch: chemical (battery) -> electrical pathway -> light + thermal stores.

A bonfire: chemical store of wood -> thermal store of air + light pathway.
